items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I know Red Allen, I met him then... [INTERVIEWEE] We're the one who gave me stuff.

ctx.x: And know R. Simon. And when I was in New York in 1940, 1930, or 1940 was it, I know Red Allen, I met him then, and he told me that another New Orleans musician, at that time I liked New Orleans music.
We're the one who gave me stuff.
